tpl.limit_high: {sensor} at {site} is {value}, above its {level} limit of {limit}, since {since}. {why} First check: {check}
tpl.limit_low: {sensor} at {site} is {value}, below its {level} limit of {limit}, since {since}. {why} First check: {check}
tpl.silent: No readings from {sensor} at {site} since {since} (it normally reports every {every}). Its alerts can't work while it's silent. First check: the logger's power and communications, and the data export.
tpl.site_silent: Nothing has been heard from {site} since {since}: all {n} of its sensors are silent. It may have lost power or communications. First check: the site's power and telemetry link.
tpl.over_overflow: {sensor} at {site} is at {value}, at or over the overflow level, since {since}. It may be spilling. First check: pump status and inflow, and look for a spill.
tpl.near_overflow: {sensor} at {site} is {value}, within {margin} of the overflow level, since {since}. It could spill if it keeps rising. First check: whether the pumps are running and keeping up.
tpl.tank_low: {site} is down to {value} ({pct}% full) since {since}. Supply from it could fail if it keeps falling. First check: the inlet and the pumps that fill it.
tpl.source_failing: The data source {source} has failed {n} times in a row, last at {since}: {message} Readings from it are missing until it works. First check: the export, file share or connection.
why.pressure_low: Low pressure can mean a burst main, a pump trip or a closed valve.
why.pressure_high: High pressure stresses mains and can cause bursts.
why.flow_high: Unusually high flow can mean a burst or a meter fault.
why.flow_low: Low flow can mean a pump trip, a closed valve or a blockage.
why.level_high: A high level risks an overflow or spill.
why.level_low: A low level risks running dry or losing supply.
check.level_low: inflow and the pumps that fill it.
why.current_high: High current can mean wear, ragging or a blockage.
check.current_high: the pump's trip log and the wet-well level.
why.temperature_high: Overheating shortens equipment life and can trip it.
why.chlorine_low: Low chlorine can let bacteria survive in the network.
check.chlorine_low: dosing pumps and the chlorine stock.
why.chlorine_high: High chlorine causes complaints and may break the limit.
why.turbidity_high: High turbidity can shield bacteria from disinfection.
why.default: It is outside the range set for it.
check.default: the sensor and the equipment it measures.
map.no_tiles: No background map: this demo network is at a stand-in location.
al.returns: Came back {n} times since it started; last cleared {time}.
